name: Samsung DW80M9 Water Thermistor
purpose: DW80M9 §4-3 tC — thermistor table ~49.12 kΩ @ 25°C; powered signal 0.05–4.95 V at CN503 pin 4.
failureModes: Open or short — tC check code
Frozen water path — tC during heater operation
testingTips: Disconnect connector before bench ohms (CN503 pin 4)
Compare to OEM table at known tub water temperature
Verify 0.05–4.95 V with power on when harness connected

name: Samsung DW80M9 Circulation Motor Coil
purpose: DW80M9 §4-3 3C — circulation pump coil approx. 5.8 Ω ±10%.
failureModes: Open coil — 3C check code / no wash
Foreign material in pump — mechanical no-wash
testingTips: Disconnect motor connector before measuring
Check inverter PBA LED and CN901 BLDC harness
Verify nozzle spray in Smart Install step 3

name: Samsung DW80M9 Inlet Valve Coil
purpose: DW80M9 §4-3 4C — water valve coil approx. 990 Ω ±10% (890–1089 Ω).
failureModes: Open coil — 4C / no fill
Valve stuck open — OC / 4C5 false pulses
testingTips: Measure at CN401 pin 6 circuit with connector removed
Verify 110–120 V at Blue CN401-6 to White CN101 during operate
Check flow meter pulses at CN503 pin 11 during fill

name: Samsung DW80M9 Drain Pump Coil
purpose: DW80M9 §4-3 5C — drain pump coil approx. 88 Ω ±7%.
failureModes: Open coil — 5C check code
Impeller obstruction — 5C with good coil
testingTips: Disconnect drain pump connector before measuring
BLDC drain on CN902 — also check inverter PBA if LED off during run
Clear drain hose and filter before bench test

name: Samsung DW80M9 Wash Heater Element
purpose: DW80M9 §4-3 HC1 — heater element 12.14–14.16 Ω at power off.
failureModes: Open element — HC1 / no heat
Shorted element — HC overheat path
testingTips: Disconnect power before bench ohms
May measure at heater terminals or heater relay to power relay paths per manual
Verify 110–120 V at heater relay during Smart Install step 3

name: Samsung DW80M9 Detergent Dispenser
purpose: DW80M9 §4-3 — dispenser solenoid approx. 0.7–3 kΩ at CN401 pin 4.
failureModes: Open solenoid — detergent not dispensed
Relay fault — 120 V missing at CN401/CN101 during operate
testingTips: Confirm detergent loaded and lid not blocked
Dispenser operates 130 s in Smart Install Auto step 3

name: Samsung DW80M9 Dry Fan Motor
purpose: DW80M9 dry troubleshooting — dry fan coil approx. 150 Ω; FC when RPM <3000.
failureModes: Open winding — poor dry / FC code
Fan runs but poor dry — rinse aid empty or thermal actuator fault
testingTips: Fan runs 30 s in Smart Install step 5 / manual step 5
CN401 pin 10 AC dry fan; CN301 BLDC fan on applicable models

name: Samsung DW80M9 Dry Thermal Actuator
purpose: DW80M9 dry troubleshooting — thermal actuator approx. 1.45 kΩ at CN401 pin 5.
failureModes: Open actuator — auto door dry path fails
120 V missing during operate — main PBA relay
testingTips: Auto Door Open tested in Smart Install step 5 / manual step 7
dC3 when door open not sensed after actuator runs

name: Samsung DW80M9 Distributor Motor
purpose: DW80M9 §4-3 PC — distributor motor coil 3.6–4.0 kΩ.
failureModes: Open coil — PC / half-load fault
Micro switch stuck — position not detected in 120 s
testingTips: Check CN401 pin 3 distributor motor connector
Micro switch brown/violet: SHORT on / OPEN off in service test
Do not supply water during micro switch position test

name: Samsung DW80M9 Lower Vane Motor
purpose: DW80M9 §4-3 7C — vane motor coil 1.625–1.796 kΩ (Red/Black CCW, White/Black CW).
failureModes: Open coil — 7C vane reset fault
Sensor vane stuck — 0 V / 5 V sensor fault
testingTips: CN401 pins 7–8 vane forward/backward relays
CN501 pin 3 lower vane reset sensor
Sensor vane brown/black: 0 V on / 5 V off in service test

name: Samsung ME11 OTR HV Transformer Primary
purpose: ME11 §4-1 — HV transformer primary 0.410–0.475 Ω (SHV-U1870E) or 0.440–0.480 Ω (SHV-U1850C) at 20°C.
failureModes: Open (OL): transformer primary failed — no heat
Short/low: winding fault — replace transformer
testingTips: Disconnect power, discharge HV capacitor, remove primary leads before measuring
Primary and filament windings to ground must read infinite (Rx1000)

name: Samsung ME11 OTR HV Transformer Secondary
purpose: ME11 §4-1 — HV transformer secondary ~123.5 Ω ±2% or ~131.0 Ω ±2% (model-dependent).
failureModes: Open (OL): no HV output to magnetron
Out of range: replace HV transformer
testingTips: Measure secondary with leads removed; discharge capacitor first
Filament winding shows continuity — do not confuse with secondary

name: Samsung ME11 OTR Vent Blower Motor
purpose: ME11 §4-7 — continuity across run-capacitor leads reads ~94 Ω (all three windings in series).
failureModes: Open (OL): vent motor or capacitor circuit failed
Very low: shorted windings — replace blower motor
testingTips: Disconnect power, discharge run capacitor, disconnect one cap lead before measuring
Unit must be removed from wall for blower service

name: Samsung ME11 OTR Humidity Sensor Heater
purpose: ME11 §4-14 — heater terminals (H; Black and Red leads) ~30 Ω. Do NOT ohm White/Orange sensor terminals.
failureModes: Open (OL): sensor heater failed — C-10 / quick test ≥213
Very low: shorted heater — quick test <6
testingTips: Only measure Black and Red heater leads — White/Orange can damage sensor
Prefer §4-14 quick test (Auto Defrost + Popcorn) before direct ohm on sensor
